notes: Armory now includes synchronized Manufacturer, Firearm Type, Caliber, and Owner filters populated only from firearms actually in inventory.
Added a horizontal manufacturer quick-filter strip using configured manufacturer logos, with text fallback when no logo exists.
Clicking a manufacturer logo filters the Armory; clicking the selected logo again clears that manufacturer filter.
Search combines with all Armory filters and works in both Cards and Detailed views.
Added Clear filters and a live total-versus-shown summary.
Updater code is unchanged from 1.1.12.9 so this release cleanly tests the new stage-based update progress flow.
